verdict.label: duplicate
verdict.why: Both functions implement the same reconciliation subscription. They mirror the draft store into a local atom, derive a set of thread keys, and check each draft's model pick against the thread shell. They then require a live shell state and confirm the pick against the authoritative snapshot thread from that same emission. Finally they subscribe with immediate: true and clear only the drafts that are unchanged since the match. The inputs, the 'same emission' invariant, the ordering of checks, the cleanup and the identity guard are all the same. The surrounding shell-confirmation logic is a policy repeated independently, so the two copies can drift. A shared helper could take parameters for the variations: a draft-store adapter (get/subscribe/update), a function that extracts the model pick and skips ineligible drafts, and a function that clears the pick. The variations are the web draft shape (activeProvider, modelSelectionByProvider, draftThreadsByThreadKey, shouldRemoveDraft) versus the mobile shape (modelSelection, new-task and queued-edit keys, withComposerDraft). These would stay in the callers. The duplication is limited to the subscription and matching machinery, not the draft-clearing mutation.

new.name: subscribeComposerDraftModelReconciliation

source_adjudication.contract: Own model-pick reconciliation subscription/matching policy: mirror draft source into registry atom, derive persisted thread membership, extract eligible pick via adapter, verify pick against current shell then authoritative thread in a live shell snapshot from the same emission, emit matched draft identities and apply changes only to still-identical draft objects; immediate subscription and dual unsubscribe. Draft schema eligibility and clearing mutation are adapter contracts, not equivalent implementations.
source_adjudication.existing_shared_owner: draftModelPickMatchesThread owns comparing a pick with selection; Atom owns reactive dependencies. Each endpoint independently filters draft candidates, resolves authoritative live snapshot, matches thread ID, applies reference-equality guard and clears redundant model state. No shared reconciliation subscription owner found.
legitimate_variations: Mobile source is composerDraftsAtom mirrored from appAtomRegistry; web source is composerDraftStore state with draftsByThreadKey. Storage get/subscribe/update adapters remain separate.

Mobile excludes absent modelSelection, new-task keys and queued-edit keys; web excludes local draftThreads and absent activeProvider and extracts per-provider pick. Eligibility and pick extraction stay caller policy.

Mobile clears modelSelection and uses withComposerDraft; web clears modelSelectionExplicit/activeProvider/modelSelectionByProvider and may delete an empty draft via shouldRemoveDraft. These mutations are not equivalent and must remain adapter-owned.
draftModelPickMatchesThread already owns normalized comparison, including fastMode=false handling; shared helper must call it rather than duplicate it.

Same live shell emission, authoritative thread-ID lookup, identity guard, immediate subscription and both unsubscribe calls are required invariants; a generic subscribe wrapper without these policies is not the proposed owner.
